questions.question_text: What does the term "User Interface (UI)" refer to in app development?

options.text: The code that makes the app function behind the scenes
The process of testing and fixing bugs in the app
The visual elements like buttons and text that users interact with
The speed at which an app loads on a deviceCorrect Answer: C) The visual elements like buttons and text that users interact with

questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of Pygame in game development?

options.text: To design mobile apps using block-based coding
To create 2D games using Python with features like graphics and sound
To test and debug mobile applications on different devices
To build user interfaces for web applicationsCorrect Answer: B) To create 2D games using Python with features like graphics and sound

questions.question_text: In the “Dodge the Squares!” game, what happens when an enemy square reaches the bottom of the screen?

options.text: The game ends immediately
The enemy is removed, and a new one spawns at the top
The player’s speed increases automatically
The enemy changes colour and moves fasterCorrect Answer: B) The enemy is removed, and a new one spawns at the top

questions.question_text: What is a key advantage of using MIT App Inventor for beginners?

options.text: It requires advanced knowledge of Python programming
It allows coding through drag-and-drop blocks instead of typing syntax
It is used only for creating complex 3D games
It works exclusively on desktop computers without mobile supportCorrect Answer: B) It allows coding through drag-and-drop blocks instead of typing syntax

questions.question_text: In the “Random Meme Picker” app, what component is used to display the random meme quote to the user?

options.text: Button
Image
Label
ClockCorrect Answer: C) Label

questions.question_text: Why is testing an essential step in app or game development?

options.text: It ensures the app uses the latest programming language
It helps identify and fix bugs while improving user experience
It automatically adds new features to the app
It guarantees the app will be popular among usersCorrect Answer: B) It helps identify and fix bugs while improving user experience
